title: Purple Tulip
body:
"Purple tulips are majestic flowers associated with luxury and elegance."

Description

The Purple Tulips are sellable flowers, that can be found around in the Finlay and Flowering Meadows regions and can be sold to Jer Junkman for 25$ per tulip. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.92% per flower.
